title: QUIC quic-go Client Download-Liveness Completion Boundary Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, helper-level body-copy regression tests, and artifact inspection.
preconditions: The updated current-status note is present.
The new requirement-home test file is present.
The advisory major-peer evidence narrative is available in the repository.
scope: Verify that the repository can formalize the quic-go client download-liveness candidate as a bounded source-length completion contract without turning the msquic TLS-alert-50 cells into local transport support evidence.
procedure: Review `docs/current-status.md` and `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-INT.json` to confirm the slice is formalized.
Inspect the new architecture and work-item artifacts for the same source-length completion boundary.
Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0023`.
Confirm the current-status note keeps the slice bounded and does not widen it into a generic keepalive or server-role behavior.
expected_result: The repository can identify the quic-go client download-liveness candidate as a formal bounded completion slice while keeping the msquic TLS-alert-50 cells outside the local candidate set.
status_summary: Complete. The slice now binds the client download path to the mounted source-length completion boundary and keeps the runtime surface bounded to that path.

supplemental_sections.heading: Scope
supplemental_sections.content: This verification only covers the bounded completion slice. It does not claim transport support for msquic or a generic keepalive policy.
